prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Tocopherol content acts as a partial endogenous antioxidant that delays lipid oxidation, with a strong correlation between initial tocopherol levels and preservation of oxidation-susceptible compounds during storage.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09783","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol content in the same extracts acted as a partial endogenous antioxidant, delaying carotenoid oxidation"}]},{"text":"Nitrogen-packed dark storage conditions significantly outperform air-exposed storage in preventing oxidative degradation, with retention rates of 91–96% after 12 weeks compared to lower retention under light and aerobic conditions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09783","field":"abstract","quote":"Nitrogen-packed dark storage best preserved total carotenoids across all extracts, with retention of 91–96% at week 12"}]},{"text":"Pumpkin seed press cake contains substantial tocopherol content that can be characterized and potentially recovered to enhance antioxidant capacity of downstream products.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-09781","field":"abstract","quote":"Total tocopherol content in optimised extracts was 1.76 mg/g, recovered simultaneously without additional co-solvent adjustment"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has direct expertise in tocopherol content and stability of lipid-rich extracts under storage conditions [SYN-PUB-09783], and specific knowledge of pumpkin seed material composition [SYN-PUB-09781], but the publications focus on extraction and carotenoid stability rather than on diagnosing oxidation pathways in finished oils or optimizing nitrogen flushing equipment."}
